headline: Kality Furniture PLC placed 4th with 78/100 points, constrained by an equipment budget request exceeding the €12,000 sequa cap.
whyThisRank: Kality Furniture PLC ranks 4th in the batch with 78 points on the investment readiness track, tying Rift Valley Soaps PLC in points but separated by evaluation findings.
justification: Kality Furniture PLC achieved an overall score of 78 out of 100 points on the investment readiness track while fulfilling all primary eligibility requirements. The applicant secured full marks in expected intervention results (20/20), positive social and environmental impact (10/10), market reach (5/5), and female ownership (5/5). However, job creation potential scored 15 out of 25 points for 21 projected positions, and youth employment scored 2 out of 5 points. Additionally, a budget finding notes that the requested equipment totals 3,780,000 ETB (approximately €22,909), which exceeds the €12,000 sequa contribution limit.
strengths: Achieved full points for expected intervention results (20/20) and green/environmental impact (10/10)
Strong market footprint reaching international or export destinations (5/5)
High level of gender inclusion with 40% female ownership (5/5) and 41.9% women headcount (4/5)
watchouts: Requested equipment budget of 3,780,000 ETB (≈ €22,909) exceeds the €12,000 sequa contribution cap
Lower youth employment share, representing 25.8% of headcount (2/5 points)
Moderate score in management capacity with 3 core team members named (3/5 points)
